plainText:
Zygarde Appears (Japanese: ジガルデ、現る Zygarde, Appear) is the 586th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 38th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Xerosic discovers that the stones on are primitive Absorbers, which will allow the ultimate weapon to be powered again.
Xerosic reveals he is aware of 's existence, having been told that Team Flare was under its surveillance after AZ escaped from being captured.
Xerosic checks on Essentia's vitals, only to find that she is in battle in Anistar City.
and battle against Essentia, who struggles to fully control Xerxer due to its Legendary status.
The battle is interrupted by the arrival of Zygarde, forcing Essentia to attempt to capture it.
and Diantha arrive, but are too late to stop Essentia from taking Zygarde and escaping.
The damage done to Essentia's suit prevents Xerosic from communicating with or controlling her anymore.
Professor Sycamore receives a call from Sina and Dexio, who inform him that Team Flare has gone into hiding at Pokémon Village.
